q: Where do replacement UPS batteries go in our emissions?
title: UPS battery replacement emissions
short: New batteries are Scope 3: Category 1 if expensed, Category 2 if you treat them as capital goods, matching your accounts. Their disposal is Category 5, waste. The electricity a UPS uses is already in your Scope 2 bill.
audience: Offices, hospitals and plants with UPS systems

ul: Old batteries sent to a recycler: Category 5.

p: Use the battery supplier's figure if offered, or a per-unit footprint for lead-acid or lithium batteries by weight.

senseible: Senseible reads quantities, dates and units from your bills and invoices and shows the factor and source used on every line.
